description:
You are a Sales Manager preparing a quarterly business review (QBR) presentation for a client meeting. The presentation at ~/Documents/Presentations/quarterly_review.pptx is currently open in LibreOffice Impress and contains 8 slides. Three of these slides contain internal-only financial data that must NOT be shown to the client.

Hide the following slides (do NOT delete them — they should remain in the file but be marked as hidden):

- Slide 3: "[INTERNAL] Cost Structure Analysis"
- Slide 5: "[INTERNAL] Profit Margins by Product"
- Slide 7: "[INTERNAL] Competitive Pricing Analysis"

To hide a slide, right-click on it in the slide panel and select "Hide Slide".

After hiding all three slides, save the file (Ctrl+S). The file can be saved in either ODP or PPTX format. All 8 slides must remain in the file — only their visibility should change.

The final saved file should be in ~/Documents/Presentations/ with the name quarterly_review.pptx or quarterly_review.odp.
